content: I can’t determine the most likely next items from a single purchased item ID without access to transaction or co-purchase data.
prompt:
You are assisting a grocery retail analyst. Items are identified by numeric IDs.
A customer has bought item 12926. Which 10 items are they most likely to buy next, in order of likelihood?
Answer with 10 integer item IDs, most likely first, separated by commas or one per line. No explanation.
